comparison.objective: Candidate removes insert tangs; record flips a pancake in a pan using a turner.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer blows, and small-fragment pickup; record requires pan stabilization, turner insertion under an edge, lifting, and controlled inversion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures with all tangs contained and hardware undamaged; record requires the pancake inverted in the pan, turner returned, pan released, and arms retreated. Specs are absent.
comparison.reason: Tool-under-edge inversion of a compliant food item tests a different ability and outcome from notch fracture and recovery.
